name: social-media-watcher
description: Summarize a video from any social platform — Claude downloads it, watches the frames, transcribes the audio, and writes a structured summary.

metadata.description: A Claude Code plugin that downloads, watches, and summarizes social-media video locally.

plugins.name: social-media-watcher
plugins.description: Takes a video URL from TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, X, Reddit, Bluesky, Pinterest, Twitch, Vimeo and more; downloads it with yt-dlp, extracts keyframes and a caption-first transcript, and produces a structured summary plus a saved artifact bundle. Handles short-form and long-form video.
